instructions: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions. In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Then add the cream and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the cheese, stirring until melted. Combine the cooked pasta and the cheese sauce, then serve.
title: Creamy Garlic Pasta

instructions: Cook the gnocchi according to the package instructions, then set aside. Chop the tomatoes and sauté them in a pan until they're soft. Add the cooked gnocchi, cream, and pesto to the pan, stirring until the cream has thickened and the gnocchi are well coated. Serve hot and enjoy.
title: Creamy Pesto Gnocchi with Tomato
